gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with histologically confirmed glioblastoma per 2021 WHO classification at first progression according to RANO criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: Onfekafusp alfa (other names: L19TNF): Patients will be treated with 10 µg/kg L19TNF on Days 1, 3 and 5, and on Days 22, 24 and 26

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Safety and Efficacy of Different Administration Sequences of L19TNF With Lomustine in Glioblastoma at First Progression

role_evidence.quote: Patients will be treated in escalating cohorts of 6 patients with 10 µg/kg L19TNF on Days 1, 3 and 5, and on Days 22, 24 and 26 and lomustine at different doses on Day 1 and Day 22

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational antibody-cytokine fusion protein (L19 anti-EDB-fibronectin scFv fused to TNF), immunostimulatory

role_evidence.quote: to explore two different administration schedules of lomustine for the combination with L19TNF (ARM 1 and ARM 2)

agents.drug_class_hint: nitrosourea alkylating agent; established GBM therapy, given in every arm

source_quote.quote: MGMT promotor methylation status known or tumor tissue for analysis available.

coder_notes: Lomustine is in every arm with schedule and dose varied (sequencing with L19TNF); coded soc_backbone per C3 (rule 3 precedes rule 6), alternative would be established_therapy_experiment; either way L19TNF remains the candidate. MGMT status must be known (or tissue available) but no specific status is required, so not coded as eligibility. Lead sponsor Philogen is industry (captured by [CODE]).
